channel.title: Asha Yojana – Latest Updates
channel.description: Fresh, checked news on government schemes

item.title: 5 lakh pucca houses for Odisha under PMAY-Gramin announced at Balangir
item.description: On 14 November 2026 Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced five lakh pucca houses for poor rural families in Odisha; houses will go in phases to families found eligible in the survey.

item.title: EPFO board: PF in instalments (SWP), minimum balance cut from 25% to 10%
item.description: At its 19 November 2026 meeting EPFO's Central Board of Trustees approved monthly or quarterly PF payouts for retirees, a 10% minimum balance and a 2-month wait for final withdrawal; no start date has been given.

item.title: NSP scholarships: 30 November 2026 is the last date for many central schemes
item.description: The National Scholarship Portal's list shows 30-11-2026 as the student application deadline for AICTE, PM YASASVI, UGC and police/CAPF wards schemes, among others.

item.title: Maharashtra rabi crop insurance: apply by 15 December 2026 for wheat and gram
item.description: District-level reports say the last date for rabi 2026-27 crop insurance on irrigated wheat, gram and rabi onion in Maharashtra is 15 December 2026, with a Farmer ID required.

item.title: INSPIRE-SHE scholarship: science students can apply till 7 December
item.description: Applications for DST's INSPIRE-SHE scholarship are open: 12,000 awards, last date 7 December 2026, 11:59 pm.

item.title: Rabi 2026-27: Cabinet approves ₹62,370 crore fertiliser subsidy
item.description: On 11 November 2026 the Union Cabinet approved Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) rates for phosphatic and potassic fertilisers for Rabi 2026-27.

item.title: Delhi: ₹141.88 crore LPG aid sent to 15.46 lakh families for Diwali
item.description: In November 2026 the Delhi government sent free-LPG-cylinder assistance by DBT to 15.46 lakh ration-card families.

item.title: Uttarakhand: aid announced for over 5 lakh women under 'Baini-Bhuli' scheme
item.description: CM Dhami announced it on 17 November 2026; aid will come in two instalments, the first in December. Amount and eligibility were not stated.

item.title: Telangana: new Cheyutha pensions now due on 26 November, moved from 19 November
item.description: Reports say pensions for about 4.5 to 4.63 lakh new beneficiaries and the saree distribution will now happen on Constitution Day, 26 November 2026.

item.title: Himachal Cabinet approves ₹1,500 a month for eligible women and 300 free units of electricity
item.description: The 13 November 2026 Cabinet meeting approved the 'Mukhya Mantri Apna Parivar Sukhi Parivar Yojana'; the start date and how to apply were not stated.

item.title: Karnataka: drought relief of up to ₹5,000 per farmer, in two instalments
item.description: Karnataka says interim relief for drought-hit farmers is doubled from ₹2,500 to ₹5,000 per farmer; the second instalment is said to come 'after Diwali'.

item.title: Ladli Behna: 42nd instalment on 13 Nov 2026, ₹1,831.77 crore to about 1.25 crore women
item.description: As per PTI, Chief Minister Mohan Yadav released the 42nd Ladli Behna instalment from Pichhore (Shivpuri) on 13 November 2026.

item.title: Ayushman Bharat: proposal to reserve 112 packages for public hospitals (up from 23)
item.description: Reports say the NHA plans to reserve 89 more PM-JAY treatment packages for public hospitals only. This is a proposal, not an approval.

item.title: Life certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) deadline for pensioners: 30 November
item.description: Reports say central and state government pensioners must submit the annual life certificate by 30 November 2026, or pension may pause from December.

item.title: Bihar brings PM Fasal Bima to Rabi 2026-27; applications till 15 January 2027
item.description: Bihar is adopting PMFBY from Rabi 2026-27; reports say applications run from 15 November 2026 to 15 January 2027.

item.title: Karnataka: ration card e-KYC deadline reported extended to 30 November
item.description: Reports say Karnataka moved the ration card e-KYC date from 10 to 30 November 2026; those who miss it may lose ration.

item.title: Stand-Up India scheme extended till 31 March 2031
item.description: On 11 November 2026 the Cabinet approved five more years of Stand-Up India for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.

item.title: PM Surya Ghar: over 50 lakh homes now have rooftop solar
item.description: Business Today, citing MNRE data, reports over 50 lakh installations; the target is 1 crore homes by March 2027.
